title: From Caricature to Collective Artifact: How Persona Construction Drives Polarization in Generative Social Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2610.16498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative Social Simulation (GSS) leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to create sophisticated personas that define agents with demographics, emotions, and political opinions. While prior work shows that personas compress outputs into stereotypical caricatures, there is no comprehensive study of how these caricatures evolve into collective artifacts when they interact. Using a Twitter-like GSS platform with personas derived from the American National Elections Study (ANES), we ablate three layers of partisan identity: affective polarization markers, party identification, and vote choice, while retaining demographics, ideological positioning and important issues. We find that collective outcomes depend heavily on how survey responses are translated into personas. translated_title: 从漫画式刻板形象到集体人工制品：人设构建如何在生成式社会模拟中驱动极化
translated_abstract: 生成式社会模拟（GSS）利用大语言模型（LLM）创建精细的人格画像，通过人口统计学特征、情感和政治观点来定义智能体。尽管先前的研究表明，人格画像会将输出压缩成刻板的漫画式形象，但对于这些刻板形象在相互交互时如何演变为集体人工制品，目前尚缺乏全面研究。我们使用一个类Twitter的GSS平台，其人格画像源自美国全国选举研究（ANES）数据，对党派身份的三个层面进行消融实验：情感极化标记、党派认同和投票选择，同时保留人口统计学特征、意识形态立场和重要议题。我们发现，集体结果在很大程度上取决于调查响应如何被转化为人格画像。仅移除少数明确表达党派立场的陈述，就能使网络从近乎完全的隔离状态转变为跨党派联系接近真实Twitter网络的水平。我们认为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了在生成式社会模拟中，人设的构建方式是决定网络极化的关键因素——仅移除人格画像中少数明确的党派性陈述，就能使模拟社交网络从近乎完全的党派隔离转变为接近真实Twitter网络的跨党派联系状态。
en_tdlr: Persona construction is the decisive driver of polarization in generative social simulations: removing just a few explicitly partisan statements from personas shifts the simulated network from near-complete segregation to cross-party ties resembling those of real Twitter networks.
